name: fix139_mine
verifies: fix-139 (owner: mining a vein loops forever): G3 PS_Interact_PickOre = _AI_HoldItems It_Pickaxe, _AI_Action(PickOre, 10) where 10 is a command time in seconds (_AI_LoopAction: another cycle while GetStateTime <= (int)start + 10), then GeneratePickOreInventory (GO_Mining per stack), UsedByPlayer, PS_Interact_End. Hero PickOre: Begin 0.8 s + Loop 2.0 s, no End/Ambient -> 5 strikes, ~11 s, then the ore is in the inventory and the hero stands free. Without a pickaxe: HUD_MissingItem_Interact + FO_It_Pickaxe; a mined vein says NothingToGet, also after a save/load
notes: Nearest G3_Object_Interact_Pick_Gold_01 to the dev start (as interact_uses). 'use' waits until the use ends; 'lastwork' shows took=~10.8s (0.8 s Begin + 5 x 2.0 s). Player.log: '[use] PickOre loops=5 ...' and '[use] mined <vein> <id>: It_GoldNugget xN'. G3 veins never refill (UsedByPlayer, no respawn); no skill is needed, Perk_Mining doubles every stack. Unit tests: TimedActionTests, ObjectUseTests.OreVein_*.
